question: The Eastern Ghats stretch from the ____________ to the Nilgiris in the south.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi Valley**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Eastern Ghats,** stretching from the Mahanadi Valley to the Nilgiris in the south, traverse through** northern Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and parts of Karnataka.**
 
• These irregular hill ranges run parallel to the eastern coast of India, with numerous rivers cutting through them and flowing into the **Bay of Bengal.**
 
• Notable peaks within the** Eastern Ghats** include the Khondmal Hills, Gandhamardan Parbat, Mahendragiri, Devagiri, Chandragiri, Malyagiri, and Rampa Hills.
 
• Among them, Mahendragiri stands as the highest peak, towering at 1,501 meters above sea level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Mahanadi valley **is renowned for its fertile soil and prosperous agriculture. The Mahanadi River, stretching 900 kilometers (560 miles) in east-central India, flows through the states of Chhattisgarh and Odisha before merging into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• **The Damodar Valley**, another significant region in India, encompasses some of the nation's crucial mica and coal-mining fields, contributing significantly to the country's industrial sector.
 
• Situated amidst forests and sparsely populated areas, **the Son Valley** lies bordered by the Kaimur Range to the north and the Chota Nagpur plateau to the south, offering a scenic and tranquil environment.
 
• **The Godavari Valley** Coalfield, situated in the districts of Adilabad, Karimnagar, Khammam, and Warangal in Telangana, serves as a vital hub for coal mining operations in the region, contributing to the state's economic development.
